items.title: Mattel’s Whitney Houston Barbie Is Inspired by One of Pop’s Greatest Anthems: How To Shop Online
items.summary: Mattel has released its first Whitney Houston doll, modeled on her "I Wanna Dance With Somebody" era. It is available to order online.

items.title: AI Music Company Suno Unveils Download Caps for Free, Paid Tiers in Quest to Combat Abuse (EXCLUSIVE)
items.summary: Suno has put numbers to the download limits it announced last week: starting September 3, free users can pull down seven tracks total from their libraries, with separate caps for paying tiers. The company frames the restrictions as an anti-abuse measure as it tries to establish itself as a legitimate industry player.

items.title: Jacob Elordi Circling Ari Aster’s Next Film At A24 Starring Scarlett Johansson
items.summary: Jacob Elordi is in talks to join Scarlett Johansson in Scapegoat, a thriller Ari Aster wrote and will direct for A24. The studio has released Aster's last four films.

items.title: Charli xcx Headlines & Backstage Interviews With Jade & PinkPantheress At Outside Lands 2026 | All Access
items.summary: Billboard's sponsored Outside Lands 2026 package covers Charli xcx's headlining set along with backstage segments featuring Jade, PinkPantheress and Kwn.

items.title: CAA Signs Ashley Gill & Grant Gibbs Of Musical Comedy Duo A Twink And A Redhead
items.summary: CAA has signed Grant Gibbs and Ashley Gill, the musical comedy duo A Twink and a Redhead, whose videos draw millions of views across social platforms. The pair are currently touring large North American venues.

items.title: aespa on Lollapalooza, Lemonade, and the reality of K-pop idoldom
items.summary: aespa talk through their Lollapalooza set and what life as K-pop idols actually looks like, including the Young Thug and Vanessa Carlton songs they use to warm up before shows.

items.title: The Opener: Ti Steele makes low-cortisol hip-hop
items.summary: Ti Steele, the alt-hip-hop singer who broke through with a guest turn on skaiwater's wonderful, is preparing her next solo album, DooMBAP*'.

items.title: Brad Pitt Says He Is No Longer Sober
items.summary: Brad Pitt says he no longer abstains from alcohol, adding that a couple of instances of overconfidence taught him where his limits are.

items.title: First Artists Management Rebrands as Fam Agency, Expands With New Agent Dan North
items.summary: First Artists Management, the Los Angeles agency built around composers and music supervisors, is now FAM Agency. It has also brought on Dan North from Kraft-Engel Management, along with clients including Gabriel Mann and Marcus Norris.

items.title: Morgan Freeman on His New Blues Album and His Action-Star Dreams
items.summary: Morgan Freeman talks about Morgan Freeman's Symphonic Blues Experience, his new album, and why retirement is not on the table.

items.title: Bruce Dickinson Says Upcoming Solo Album Recorded at Dave Grohl’s Studio Is “Heavy as S**t”
items.summary: Bruce Dickinson recorded his next solo album at Dave Grohl's studio and describes the results as extremely heavy. The record is currently penciled in for 2027.

items.title: Aretha Franklin's 'Sparkle' soundtrack is a neglected classic
items.summary: Critic Ken Tucker makes the case for the soundtrack to 1976's Sparkle, a film about a '60s girl group loosely modeled on the Supremes. The movie underperformed but retains a cult audience, and Tucker argues the record holds some of Aretha Franklin's best singing.
